SevenUI is a registry of accessible React primitives built exclusively on Base UI — installed with the CLI you already use. Get started $npx shadcn@latest add @sevenui/buttonpnpm dlx shadcn@latest add @sevenui/buttonyarn dlx shadcn@latest add @sevenui/buttonbunx --bun shadcn@latest add @sevenui/button Live from the registryClick around — every part is real Create your account Email Work email — we never send marketing. The registry speaks the CLI your project already uses. 1. Initialize Set up shadcn in your project if you have not already. Existing shadcn projects skip this step. $npx shadcn@latest initpnpm dlx shadcn@latest inityarn dlx shadcn@latest initbunx --bun shadcn@latest init 2. Add primitives Install any part from the registry. Source lands in your components directory, ready to edit. $npx shadcn@latest add @sevenui/buttonpnpm dlx shadcn@latest add @sevenui/buttonyarn dlx shadcn@latest add @sevenui/buttonbunx --bun shadcn@latest add @sevenui/button 3. Use them Import from your own codebase. The source is yours now — restyle or rewrite anything. import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button" Same CLI. Different primitives. Base UI, exclusively Every part is a Base UI primitive underneath — accessible, unstyled, and maintained by the Radix team's successors at MUI. No mixed foundations, no wrappers around wrappers. The shadcn workflow Primitives are distributed as source through the shadcn registry and use the same CSS variables, so they drop into an existing shadcn project without touching your theme. Source, not a dependency The CLI copies code into your repo. There is no runtime dependency on SevenUI and nothing to pin — MIT licensed, yours to keep.
